scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build:web
scripts.build:core: tsc -b packages/domain packages/contracts packages/application packages/memory-store packages/file-store packages/sqlite-store packages/postgres-store apps/api
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:integration && npm run smoke:startup:sqlite && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-ci.sqlite npm run db:migrate:sqlite:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-ci.sqlite RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD_METADATA=false npm run preflight:runtime:built && npm run smoke:shutdown:sqlite && npm run smoke:ui && npm run smoke:ui:operator-auth && npm run smoke:local-demo
scripts.ci:static: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-ci-static.sqlite npm run db:migrate:sqlite:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-ci-static.sqlite RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD_METADATA=false npm run preflight:runtime:built
scripts.ci:storage: npm run test:integration && npm run smoke:startup:sqlite && npm run smoke:shutdown:sqlite
scripts.ci:browser:quick: npm run build && npm run smoke:ui:content:built && npm run smoke:ui:json-roster:built && npm run smoke:ui:participant-entry:built && npm run smoke:ui:activation-roster-warnings:built
scripts.ci:deployability: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/deployability-ci.sqlite npm run db:migrate:sqlite:built && APP_BUILD_SHA=${APP_BUILD_SHA:-local-deployability} APP_BUILD_TIMESTAMP=${APP_BUILD_TIMESTAMP:-1970-01-01T00:00:00Z} FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/deployability-ci.sqlite RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD_METADATA=true npm run preflight:runtime:built && APP_BUILD_SHA=${APP_BUILD_SHA:-local-deployability} APP_BUILD_TIMESTAMP=${APP_BUILD_TIMESTAMP:-1970-01-01T00:00:00Z} FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/deployability-startup.sqlite FIRST_SLICE_OPERATOR_AUTH_REQUIRED=true npm run smoke:startup:built
scripts.ci:postgres: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=postgres npm run db:migrate:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=postgres npm run db:doctor:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=postgres RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD_METADATA=false npm run preflight:runtime:built && npm run smoke:startup:postgres:built && npm run test:integration:postgres:built && npm run smoke:ui:postgres:built
scripts.ci:fast: npm run build && npm run test:unit:built && npm run test:integration:sqlite:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/smoke-startup-fast.sqlite npm run smoke:startup:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-fast.sqlite npm run db:migrate:sqlite:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/preflight-fast.sqlite RUNTIME_PREFLIGHT_REQUIRE_BUILD_METADATA=false npm run preflight:runtime:built && npm run smoke:ui:content:built
scripts.smoke:docker:runtime: npm run smoke:docker:build && npm run smoke:docker:runtime:built
scripts.db:doctor:postgres: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=postgres node ./scripts/storage-admin.mjs doctor
scripts.db:doctor:sqlite: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite node ./scripts/storage-admin.mjs doctor
scripts.db:migrate:postgres: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=postgres node ./scripts/storage-admin.mjs migrate
scripts.db:migrate:sqlite: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite node ./scripts/storage-admin.mjs migrate
scripts.smoke:shutdown:sqlite: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/smoke-shutdown.sqlite SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_DELAY_MS=2000 node ./scripts/smoke-shutdown.mjs
scripts.smoke:ui:review-readiness: npm run build && UI_SMOKE_STOP_AFTER_STEP=filter-reviews FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/ui-smoke-review-readiness.sqlite node ./scripts/smoke-ui.mjs
scripts.smoke:ui:operator-auth: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_OPERATOR_AUTH_REQUIRED=true FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/ui-smoke-auth.sqlite node ./scripts/smoke-ui.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run build:core && npm run test:unit:built
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:integration:memory && npm run test:integration:sqlite
scripts.test:integration:sqlite: npm run build && npm run test:integration:sqlite:built
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b --pretty packages/domain packages/contracts packages/application packages/memory-store packages/file-store packages/sqlite-store packages/postgres-store apps/api && ng build rewrite-app-web --configuration development
scripts.start:local: npm run build && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/local.sqlite npm run db:migrate:sqlite:built && FIRST_SLICE_STORE=sqlite FIRST_SLICE_SQLITE_FILE=./.data/local.sqlite FIRST_SLICE_OPERATOR_AUTH_REQUIRED=true FIRST_SLICE_BOOTSTRAP_DEMO=true node ./scripts/with-build-metadata.mjs npm run start:api
